ORDINANCE XLVII OF 1999
NAZARIA-E-PAKISTAN
FOUNDATION(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
ORDINANCE
XLVII OF 1999
An Ordinance to
amend the Nazaria-e-Pakistan Foundation Act, 1997
[Gazette
of Punjab, Extraordinary, 13th September, 1999]
No. Legis.
3(XLVII)/99, dated 13-9-1999.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
1.
Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Nazaria-e-Pakistan Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It
shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the
day the Nazaria-e-Pakistan Foundation (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999 (XXVI of
1999) stands repealed under Article 128(2) of the Constitution.

Amendment of section 2 of Act XII of 1997.--In the Nazaria-e- Pakistan

Amendment of section 4 of Act XII of 1997

[Gazette
of Punjab, Extraordinary, 13th September, 1999]
No. Legis.
3(XLVII)/99, dated 13-9-1999.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the
Governor of the Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
3.
Amendment of section 4 of Act XII of 1997.--In the said Act, in section 4,
for subsections (2), (3), (4) and (5), the following shall be substituted:--
(2)(a) The
Board shall consist of not more than 24 founder members.
(b) The
term of office of a member shall be 10 years.
(c)
Vacancies in the Board shall be filled in by the Board and the term of office
of the members so appointed shall be 3 years.
(3)(a) The
Board shall elect one of its members as the Chairman of the Board.
(b) The
term of office of the Chairman shall be 5 years.
(4) A
member of the Board may be removed from his office by the Board by a vote of
the majority of the members of the Board on the ground of misconduct or
ineptitude or mental or physical incapacity after being given an opportunity of
being heard.

4. Amendment of section 6 of Act XII of 1997.--In
the said Act after subsection (2) the following subsection (3) shall be
added:--
"(3)
The Board may set up Committees and Sub-Committees and delegate any of its
powers to such Committees or to any of its officers.".
